profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hugo
profile.summary:
As a Technical Lead at Culture Amp, I lead a team of five engineers across three time zones in the US and Australia. We develop a cutting-edge messaging platform for seamless communication across various work platforms. I have implemented integrations with popular platforms like Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email to handle millions of monthly messages efficiently. I have also achieved a significant increase in user engagement and satisfaction by delivering a world-class messaging experience.

In my previous roles as a Senior Software Engineer at Disco and a Software Engineer at Causely, Inc., I developed a recognition-based messaging platform for celebrating employees via Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Hangouts. I built a top-of-the-line front end on React, providing advanced performance metrics to customers. I also supported in the acquisition by Culture Amp, ensuring a smooth transition and integration. I have strong leadership and project management skills, and I am passionate about creating innovative solutions that enhance user experience and satisfaction.

• Achieved a significant increase in user engagement and satisfaction by delivering a world-class messaging experience.

projects.title: BlackBerry
projects.description: I joined the Software Updates team for Q10, Z10 and Z30 mobile phones. Initially, I started in the UI development team fixing bugs and adding new functionality, using AdobeAIR, CodeCollaborator and SVN. Then I participated in the migration of the system to C++/Cascades using JIRA and GIT.
